concerns.text: Task T021 is a placeholder '{{claim:c_d1be7108}}' with no implementation description. It fails to cover FR-003 (Elastic Net training with nested 5-fold CV) and SC-001 (Pearson r calculation). The spec requires a concrete task to implement the model training logic, which is currently missing.

Tasks T023 (Bootstrap CI) and T024 (Empirical p-value) are marked incomplete `[ ]`. These are required to satisfy SC-001 (confidence intervals) and FR-004 (empirical p-value). Without these tasks, the core validation of the predictive model cannot be executed.

Task T017 (Aggregating features into feature_matrix.csv) is marked incomplete `[ ]`. This is a hard dependency for User Story 2 (T021-T026) and FR-002 (30 features extraction). The pipeline cannot proceed to modeling without this task being defined and executable.

Task T034 (Generating diagnostics_report.md) is marked incomplete `[ ]`. This task is required to satisfy the 'Independent Test' of User Story 3 and SC-002/SC-003/SC-004 (FDR, VIF, sensitivity analysis). The required evidence for statistical rigor will not be produced.

Task T022 contains a placeholder `[deferred]` for the number of permutation repetitions. While planning docs can defer empirical values, the task must explicitly state the logic to perform the 1,000 iterations mandated by FR-004, or define the dynamic reduction logic clearly. Currently, it reads 'Repeat this [deferred] times', which is ambiguous for implementation.

Task T033 states 'sweep α from to in steps of 0.05'. The start and end values for the regularization sweep are missing, rendering the task incomplete and the resulting analysis unverifiable against FR-003/FR-007.

Task T031 contains a raw template artifact `{{claim:c_0a7fbd7e}}` inside the description. This placeholder must be resolved to a specific citation or removed to ensure the VIF calculation logic is fully defined and traceable.
